record.field: Correct Keys of Closed Boxes | BN

Reg = env['donation.box.registration.installation'].sudo() Key = env['key'].sudo() Issuance = env['key.issuance'].sudo() now = datetime.datetime.now()
issuance_states = dict(Issuance.fields_get(['state'])['state']['selection']) out_states = [s for s in ('issued', 'overdue', 'pending', 'donation_receive') if s in issuance_states] has_collection = 'rider_collection_id' in Issuance.fields_get() no_money = ('donation_not_collected', 'paid')
boxes = (records.sudo() if records else Reg.search([])).filtered(lambda r: r.status == 'close')
fixed_boxes = 0 fixed_keys = 0 returned = Issuance kept = Issuance for box in boxes: keys = Key.search([('donation_box_registration_installation_id', '=', box.id)]) open_issuances = Issuance.search([('key_id', 'in', keys.ids), ('state', 'in', out_states)]) bad_keys = keys.filtered(lambda k: k.state != 'closed' or k.key_bunch_id) if not open_issuances and not bad_keys: continue fixed_boxes += 1 box_kept = open_issuances.filtered( lambda i: has_collection and i.state != 'donation_receive' and i.rider_collection_id and i.rider_collection_id.state not in no_money) for issuance in open_issuances - box_kept: issuance.write({'state': 'returned', 'returned_on': now}) issuance.message_post(body='Returned: box %s was taken out of service.' % (box.lot_id.display_name or box.display_name)) returned |= open_issuances - box_kept kept |= box_kept for key in bad_keys: key.write({'state': 'closed', 'key_bunch_id': False}) fixed_keys += len(bad_keys) box.message_post(body='Correction: the key of this closed box was closed and removed from its bunch; ' '%s open issuance(s) returned, %s left open with money to settle at the POS.' % (len(open_issuances - box_kept), len(box_kept)))
# keys closed earlier but still listed in a bunch stray = Key.search([('state', '=', 'closed'), ('key_bunch_id', '!=', False)]) stray.write({'key_bunch_id': False})
if not fixed_boxes and not stray: message = 'Nothing to correct: every closed box already has its key closed.' else: message = '%s closed box(es) corrected: %s key(s) closed and removed from their bunch, %s issuance(s) returned.' % ( fixed_boxes, fixed_keys, len(returned)) if stray: message += ' %s closed key(s) removed from their bunch.' % len(stray) if kept: message += ' Left open, money still to settle at the POS: %s' % ', '.join( '%s (%s)' % (i.name, i.key_id.display_name) for i in kept[:20]) log(message) action = { 'type': 'ir.actions.client', 'tag': 'display_notification', 'params': {'title': 'Closed Box Keys', 'message': message, 'type': 'warning' if kept else 'success', 'sticky': bool(kept)}, }
